usage.outputShape: body.results[] (web results, each {title,link,desc,snippet,source}); body.social[]; body.videos[]; body.images[] ({image,thumbnail,link,width,height}); body.answer (string, often empty); body.metrics.{intent,total_results_found}
quirks: q is the required query param (NOT 'query'); pass it in the URL query string since this is GET
Results split across separate arrays: body.results (web), body.social, body.videos, body.images — not a single flat list
body.answer is frequently empty even though service is described as conversational/answer-style; rely on body.results[]

Optional params: limit (1-100), depth (fast|deep), intent (e.g. NewsSearchIntent, ImageSearchIntent), dateRange (24h|7d|30d|1y), country, language, safe, extracts, includeDomains/excludeDomains — all as query params
usage.guide: Call GET https://x402.orth.sh/andi/v1/search with at least the required q query param (the search query), e.g. ?q=react%20hooks%20tutorial&limit=10. Payment is handled via x402 (USDC on Base, ~$0.01/call, no API key). Read web results from body.results[] (each has title, link, desc, snippet, source); related media is in body.social[], body.videos[], and body.images[]. body.answer is often empty so do not depend on it — synthesize from results. Tune with optional query params like depth=deep, intent=NewsSearchIntent, or dateRange=7d.
